Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

hobby — an activity you enjoy in free time. Example: My hobby is photography.
sport — a physical game or activity. Example: I do sport every week.
music — sounds made with voices or instruments. Example: I love listening to music.
game — an activity with rules you play. Example: I play games with my friends.
weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: What are you doing this weekend?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My hobbies are ...
• I love ... because ...
• I play ... every weekend.
• In my free time I ...
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Like / Love / Hate + -ing.
Present your hobbies in three parts: what you like, how often, and why. Use like + -ing and frequency adverbs: I love playing music. I play every weekend because it is relaxing.
